hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition 97887 MiB

hypothesis: Reuse each projection weight row from shared memory across four consecutive encoder rows while preserving the parent thread/reduction order independently per row.

prototype.scope: single, triple-QKV, bias-fc1, and bias-residual-fc2 encoder projections
prototype.arithmetic: byte-exact to each parent projection in the focused real-GPU primitive gate
prototype.reason_removed: The complete route regressed both the six-short-file and actual 20-fixture product distributions.

profile_baseline.interpretation: Projection families dominate the current encoder, so exact row reuse was a reasonable first RT-3 screen.
profile_baseline.attribution_method: Encoder-only instances selected by exact expected counts and rows>1 geometry from the node-level Nsight trace; full-route family totals also contain decoder instances and must not be assigned wholesale to the encoder.

six_short_file_complete_route.protocol: two warmups plus ten timed attempts/file; six retained 2-11-token files; conditional exact-EOS decode active

downstream_20_fixture_screen.protocol: 20 FLEURS-through-EOU fixtures; five alternating iterations; 100 observations/route

decision: Reject and remove the rowbatch4 prototype. Retain the exact current custom encoder. Continue RT-3 with other launch/memory candidates; do not infer a win from shared weight reuse.
limitations: The prototype was measured from an uncommitted worktree and then removed; raw hashes preserve the negative evidence.
The six-short-file route and 20-fixture product screen both failed decisively, so no expensive full quality campaign was run.
The exact primitive result establishes correctness only, not value; complete-route performance decides the rejection.
